effect_description_eng:
[Security] [Opponent's Turn] All of your [Royal Base] trait Digimon gain ＜Reboot＞ (Unsuspend this Digimon during your opponent's unsuspend phase.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Add your top face-down security card to the hand. Then, you may place 1 [Royal Base] trait Digimon card from your hand face up as the bottom security card.
